copy.title: App Toolkit: Your toolkit
copy.headline: App Toolkit. Your toolkit.
copy.description: App Toolkit for Android opens into live tools for direction, measuring, counting and everyday choices. Watch the toolbox become your toolkit in one app.
copy.longDescription: The App Toolkit toolbox opens and its live widgets spring out. They settle into the app's bento layout as a Pixel phone and the rest of the interface appear. Quick Tools, Measure and Play & Decide finish the tour, accompanied by the complete supplied soundtrack.
copy.altText: A toolbox opens into live widgets that assemble into App Toolkit's three screens on Pixel phones.

output/images/contact-sheet.png.title: App Toolkit: trailer review
output/images/contact-sheet.png.altText: Eight scenes show the toolbox opening, widgets gathering, three app destinations and the final brand shot.
